01 · iOS app · my own project

Elite
Hypertrophy.

An iOS workout app. You set up routines, log exercises and sets, and look back at your progress. It also has friends and posts.

01

What it does

  • workout routines
  • exercise and set logging
  • progress history
  • user profiles
  • friends and posts
02

How it's built

The interface is SwiftUI. The data lives in Supabase.

Language
Swift
Interface
SwiftUI
Backend
Supabase
Beta distribution
Apple TestFlight
03

Testing

Beta builds go out through Apple TestFlight. The tests cover accounts, workouts, the social features, and whether data is saved.

The source for the app isn't public. Email me about it ↗
